messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Unable to load aroma (perhaps installation is not successful)
parts:
Hi,
I am confused about what directions you are following. The code to
install/update aroma.affymetrix (see the group pages) is

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

It appears you are installing just two specific packages that
aroma.affymetrix uses.

Best,
Elizabeth
